title: SvelteKit experimental remote function parsing can block the event loop
summary: A crafted request can stall parsing in applications that enable experimental remote functions and use form, query or command remote functions.

severity.rationale: The documented impact is denial of service in a server worker. Experimental remote functions must be enabled and used, limiting exposure and supporting a 30-day response.

exposure: Only applications using the experimental remote functions flag and form, query or command remote functions meet the documented prerequisite.

remediation.details: Use SvelteKit 3.1.1 or later, whose release notes describe linear-time remote form parsing.
remediation.risk: Updating from the affected 2.x series crosses a major version; test application compatibility.

verification: Confirm @sveltejs/kit is 3.1.1 or later and test legitimate remote function calls.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
